lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mg16Co4 (reduced formula Mg4Co) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both elements: each Co center has 12 Mg neighbors, and each Mg center has 12 neighbors comprising 4 Co and 8 Mg, with neighbor distances from 2.9515 to 3.1343 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Co- and Mg-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 20 sites.
